name: Remlifanserin
summary: Remlifanserin is a selective serotonin 5-HT2A receptor inverse agonist which is under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease psychosis. It is taken by mouth.

pharmacology.text: Remlifanserin (INN; developmental code name ACP-204) is a selective serotonin 5-HT2A receptor inverse agonist which is under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease psychosis. It is more potent and selective than pimavanserin as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor inverse agonist. Remlifanserin shows very low affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor compared to the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors.

uses.text: Remlifanserin (INN; developmental code name ACP-204) is a selective serotonin 5-HT2A receptor inverse agonist which is under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease psychosis. Remlifanserin is under development by Acadia Pharmaceuticals. As of January 2025, it is in phase 3 clinical trials.
